items.title: Clippers rerouting the 2027 Philadelphia 2nd, which they got in the Johni Broome deal, to land Max Strus, even on an expiring, is a pretty good piece of business. They got something for John Collins leaving and turned it all into a very viable rotation piece. Hard to find fault.
items.author: Justin Russo

items.title: Max Strus’s $16.7 million salary for next season fits in the $17 million trade exception the Clippers had from the John Collins sign-and-trade with Detroit. Strus’s contract is expiring. The wing only played 12 games last season but is a quality shooter and connector.

items.title: The LA Clippers will acquire Max Strus via the $17M John Collins TPE they created earlier this offseason.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
The LA Clippers will acquire Max Strus via the $17M John Collins TPE they created earlier this offseason.

The Cavs will be roughly $46.3M under what will now be a first-apron hard cap after acquiring Peyton Watson via S&T.

1/2
